name: TheTVDB Metadata
overview: Reference implementation of Shoko's metadata provider contract, supplying TheTVDB v4 series, season and episode metadata for the `tvdb` metadata source. This is a stub manifest, not the published one. If you are reading it as a repository feed, you are on the wrong branch: the published identity and releases live on this repository's `metadata` branch, at `manifest.json`. CI pulls that file over this one before it builds anything. This copy exists so a local build has an id to match against.
